title: backlog.py cost of a sprint shows the paid benchmark run its items recorded
goal: backlog.py cost SP shows, beside the sessions it attributes, the spend of a paid benchmark run the sprint's items recorded in kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv (the repro rows' cost by record), so a sprint whose real spend was a detached run is not read as the workers' few dollars. SP-ccvfvoqj: cost --rework read 77 requests of the workers while the repro run spent $178.02 in sessions outside every window.
